title: Vibrant Silky Mexican Mincemeat Tlayudas
description: A fresh and silky Mexican dish featuring mincemeat, served on agave leaves, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This plant-based friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Veracruzan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook until the mixture is soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the mincemeat, lime juice, salt, and pepper, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Arrange the agave leaves on a baking sheet and spoon the mincemeat mixture onto the center of each leaf.
Fold the leaves over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Bake the tlayudas in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the leaves are slightly browned and the filling is heated through.
Remove the tlayudas from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Serve the tlayudas hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
